title: Kleshchev multipartitions, affine Mirković-Vilonen polytopes, and representations of KLR algebras in type ${\tt A}^{(1)}_1$
summary: We construct explicit isomorphisms between three models for the $B(\infty)$ crystal in type ${\tt A}_1^{(1)}$: affine Mirković--Vilonen polytopes, Kleshchev multipartitions, and a new model we call upper ledge diagrams. We also present some clarifying results on these crystals, giving a direct method for completing an affine MV polytope from the data of one of its boundary root partitions, and a non-iterative recognition theorem which characterizes Kleshchev multipartitions in type ${\tt A}_1^{(1)}$.
